subject: Private environment carve & proration — canary plan, SOW, and legal asks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Arielle Greene <arielle.greene@orthosys.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private environment carve & proration — initial SOW and canary suggestion

Hi Arielle —

Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week. Per our call, I attached a draft SOW that captures the private VPC footprint you asked for (3 isolated clusters: staging, canary, prod), the tenancy carve for analytics, and the uplifted HA standby nodes. A few notes up front: 

- We propose a two-week canary window (staging -> canary) before final prod cutover to validate KV cache behavior and prefix caching at your expected QPS.
- Pricing: the SOW shows the standard renewal term but with a prorated credit for the unused Dedicated burst reserve in Q3; I've marked the credit line in the doc.
- Timeline: proposed start week is Sep 13 - includes a 3-day maintenance window for network pairing and cert install.

Can you confirm: (1) the desired cutover week, (2) if your security team needs any additional evidence beyond SOC2 snapshot, and (3) procurement PO contact?

I CC'd Sergio to coordinate the ops runbook and Neha (for post-cutover CS follow-up) — happy to walk the SOW in a quick call if helpful.

Attachments: SOW_OrthoSys_Private_Env_v3.pdf, network-segmentation-diagram.png

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187

Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform for reliable LLM serving
From: Arielle Greene <arielle.greene@orthosys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@orthosys.com>, procurement@orthosys.com
Date: 2027-08-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private environment carve & proration — initial SOW and canary suggestion

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Reviewed the SOW with Tom and our infra lead. A few items from our side: 

1) Canary scope: we need the canary cluster to mirror the prod dataset (masked) and include the analytics ingest path. Is that covered in your diagram?
2) Isolation: we must ensure the VPC peering uses dedicated egress IPs for our partner integrations (security requirement). Can you confirm network pairing supports static egress?
3) SOC2: procurement will want a short evidence bundle (summary + auditor contact). The SOC2 snapshot you included should be fine, but we may ask for the auditor contact for validation.
4) Billing & Credits: procurement asked for the proration math spelled out per line item.

We can target Sep 20 for cutover if you need an extra week. Also — we will need a signed SOW and PO by Sep 10 to meet our internal change window.

Thanks,
Arielle Greene
Head of Platform Engineering, OrthoSys Health
arielle.greene@orthosys.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-25T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: FW: OrthoSys asks — canary scope, egress IPs, SOC2 evidence, proration

Team — forwarding Arielle's notes. Quick alignment: 

- Canary dataset: ops will need a masking plan; Sergio can confirm if we need additional storage for a mirrored masked ingest. Action: Sergio to estimate storage + runbook (Z) by EOD Thu 8/26.
- Static egress: product/infra should confirm support; if not, we can provide NAT gateway + reserved public IPs (billing impact). Sergio, call this out in est.
- SOC2 auditor contact: Kimberly, can you attach a one-page evidence summary + auditor email from legal? Arielle may ask procurement to reach out.
- Proration math: propose showing line-by-line proration in an appendix and a single consolidated credit line in the invoice. Neha, can you draft the invoice stub with credit by Fri 8/27?

Proposed customer ask: accept SOW v3 + PO by 2027-09-10. If we need a quick review call, I'll join.

-Marissa
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-26T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OrthoSys asks — SOC2 evidence and minor redlines

Marissa — attaching the one-page SOC2 summary and auditor contact (see attachment SOC2-snapshot-Aug2027.zip). A couple of contract redlines I want to flag before we send the final SOW: 

- Data residency clause (Section 4.2): Arielle wants explicit language that analytics telemetry hosted in the carve will be stored within the US region only. We can add an operation-level SLA + audit right.
- SLA exception during cutover: legal prefers limiting SLA credits during scheduled maintenance windows; propose a 6-hour maintenance window per cluster during migration days.

If you want to expedite signature, I can accept these in an amendment email that Arielle can approve inline; otherwise we'll add the language to SOW v4.

-Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Arielle Greene <arielle.greene@orthosys.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-27T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private environment carve & proration — SOW v3 + updated notes (requested items included)

Arielle — thanks, all good notes. I've attached an updated SOW (v3.1) and a short migration checklist. Summary of changes: 

- Canary: clarified that canary will use a masked replica of the production analytics stream. Ops will provide the masking runbook and estimate.
- Network: we can provide reserved egress IPs via NAT + reserved elastic IPs; Sergio's ops estimate is included in appendix B.
- Data residency: added explicit US-residency language for analytics telemetry and an audit-rights paragraph per Kimberly's note.
- Maintenance windows: added 6-hour maintenance allowance per cluster during migration days; SLA credit table updated accordingly.
- Proration: added a line-by-line proration appendix and a consolidated credit amount; Neha included an invoice stub.

Attachments: SOW_OrthoSys_Private_Env_v3.pdf (SOW v3.1 pages highlighted), network-segmentation-diagram.png, SOC2-snapshot-Aug2027.zip

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) Arielle to confirm accept + issue PO by 2027-09-10 to hit Sep 20 cutover.
2) Sergio to run the masking/storage estimate and ops runbook by 8/30.
3) Kimberly to route SOC2 contact if procurement requests a call.

Would you like a 30-minute call Wed 8/31 to walk through the runbook?

Best,
Marissa
From: Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@orthosys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@orthosys.com
Cc: Arielle Greene <arielle.greene@orthosys.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private environment carve & proration — accept and PO forthcoming

Marissa — we reviewed SOW v3.1 internally and we're good to proceed. A few final notes from procurement: 

- PO will be raised today (PO# OS-4729) with net-30 billing and the consolidated proration credit reflected as a separate line. Expect the PDF to land in your inbox from procurement@orthosys.com.
- Our infra team confirmed reserved egress IPs are acceptable — they'll share the destination firewall rules on the 8/31 runbook call.
- Can you confirm who will own the masking operation during canary? We prefer Redwood to run the masking process for parity; if so, please confirm the support hours and point-of-contact.

Once we have PO we can lock Sep 20 for cutover. Thanks — looking forward to a smooth run.

Tom Barnes
Director, Infrastructure Operations | OrthoSys Health
